# Bidnam Lee

> Personal site of Bidnam Lee, a brand and business strategy consultant and AI builder based in Brooklyn, NY. Global Partner at Ogilvy Consulting and founder of OC Labs, its internal AI product studio. Previously consulting hire #2 at COLLINS, and an award-winning copywriter before that (Nike Breaking2).

Key facts:

- Current role: Global Partner at Ogilvy Consulting, leading brand and business transformation for enterprise clients
- Founder of OC Labs, an AI product studio inside Ogilvy Consulting, building AI-enabled tools for strategy work
- Expertise: brand strategy and positioning, business and marketing transformation, innovation strategy, value creation for PE-backed companies, AI-enabled product development
- Selected clients: IBM, UiPath, Verizon Business, Blackstone portfolio companies (Andmore, Sustana), 7-Eleven, Alcon, XFL, ZOA Energy, Bartesian, Fierce Finance
- Earlier career: consulting hire #2 at COLLINS, which earned AdAge's Business Transformation Agency of the Year; copywriter on award-winning Nike campaigns including Breaking2
- Contact: bidnam@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/bidnam/
